title: Model of Care Intervals, Contact Attempts and Caseloads in the Special Needs Plans Category
content:
The intervals on which a member of a Special Needs Plans package is assessed and reviewed, the attempts the care team makes to reach a member, the members one care manager may carry and the years the approved model of care runs before renewal are fixed by the package.

## Assessment and review intervals, in calendar days

| Plan benefit package | First health risk assessment, counted from the coverage effective date | Annual health risk assessment, counted from the previous assessment | Care plan review, high-risk member | Care plan review, low-risk member |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | 90 | 365 | 90 | 180 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | 90 | 365 | 60 | 180 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 90 | 365 | 120 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 90 | 365 | 120 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 90 | 365 | 120 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | 45 | 365 | 30 | 90 |

## Care team, caseload and model of care

| Plan benefit package | Attempts made before a member is recorded as unreachable | Calendar days between interdisciplinary care team meetings | Members one care manager may carry | Calendar days after an inpatient discharge for the transition review | Years the approved model of care runs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | 3 | 90 | 85 | 7 | 3 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | 3 | 60 | 60 | 3 | 3 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 3 | 180 | 140 | 14 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 3 | 180 | 140 | 14 | 3 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 3 | 180 | 140 | 14 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | 2 | 30 | 45 | 2 | 3 |

## Basis of each column

The first assessment column is the calendar days from the coverage effective date within which the first health risk assessment must be completed, and the annual column the calendar days from the previous assessment within which the annual one must be completed. The two review columns are the calendar days between care plan reviews for a high-risk and for a low-risk member. The attempts column is how many attempts the care team makes before recording a member as unreachable. The meeting column is the calendar days between interdisciplinary care team meetings, and the caseload column the members one care manager may carry. The transition column is the calendar days after an inpatient discharge within which a transition review must happen, and the last column the years the plan's approved model of care runs before it must be renewed.

## Reading two rows

For Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) the intervals are the shortest in the category: a first assessment within 45 calendar days, a care plan review every 30 calendar days for a high-risk member and every 90 for a low-risk member, an interdisciplinary team meeting every 30 calendar days, a transition review within 2 calendar days of an inpatient discharge, 2 attempts before a member is recorded as unreachable, and 45 members to a care manager, under a model of care approved for 3 years.

For the three chronic condition packages the figures agree in every column but one: each carries a first assessment within 90 calendar days, an annual assessment within 365, reviews every 120 and 365 calendar days, 3 attempts, meetings every 180 calendar days, 140 members to a care manager and a transition review within 14 calendar days, while the approved model of care runs 2 years for Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) and Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) and 3 years for Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP).
